info.laundry: Coin-operated washer and dryer ($2.00 per wash / $2.00 per dry). Please avoid using machines after 9:30 PM.
info.trash: Please dispose of all household trash in the large dumpsters located next to the garage entrance.
info.park: Direct access to Morningside Park (walking paths, tennis/basketball courts, playground, waterfront views).
info.hotWater: Central hot water system. During peak evening hours (around 8:00 PM), please allow water to run briefly.
info.smoking: STRICTLY PROHIBITED inside all guest rooms. Allowed ONLY at the designated outdoor wooden bench area. Additional cleaning fees apply for violations.
info.package: On-site package delivery is not accepted. Please route orders to a nearby UPS Store or FedEx Office.
info.parking: Free parking on the street next to the property. The area inside the garage gate is strictly private property.

housekeeping.longTermPolicy: For stays exceeding 10 nights, mandatory housekeeping service is required every 10 days.

rules.quietHours: 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM. In respect of neighboring guests, no parties or events are permitted.
rules.acGuidelines: Keep AC on automatic mode and never set below 70°F to prevent unit freezing and condensation. Please keep all doors and windows closed while running.
rules.security: Please keep room doors locked at all times. Guests are responsible for damages or stolen items, the cost of which will be deducted from the deposit.
